OTel Collector
panels.description: The OTel Collector receives all telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), processes it through filters/enrichment, and exports to Gigapipe. Watch Queue Usage — above 80% means backpressure, data may be dropped.

panels.title: OTel — Data Dropped by Filter (rate/s)
panels.description: Shows how many data points each filter drops per second. Only filters that actively remove data appear here.

panels.title: Gigapipe
panels.description: Gigapipe is the LGTM-compatible API layer. Writer handles ingestion from OTel Collector. Readers handle Grafana queries. High send time or connection resets indicate ClickHouse pressure.
Time spent sending batch to ClickHouse.
panels.title: Gigapipe — Send Time (ms)
ClickHouse (Summary)
panels.description: ClickHouse stores all observability data. Active parts > 300 indicates merge pressure. Failed queries correlate with dashboard blank moments. Memory is the primary constraint for query performance.
